required_evidence: Signed hash-bound verifier return from a registered independent identity.
acceptance_test: Return contract validates and canonical gate transition is independently authorized.
dependencies: External verifier identity and trust bootstrap
notes: No AI or same-owner mechanical check can satisfy this gate.

action: Close and independently challenge the narrow novelty claim.
required_evidence: Reproducible search snapshots; strongest-predecessor reconciliation; signed independent challenge.
acceptance_test: NOVELTY_SURVIVES or an accountable REFRAME/STOP decision is recorded.

action: Resolve the result-blind methods challenge and freeze the confirmatory contract.
required_evidence: Accepted PC03 return; final estimands; replicate counts; precision; multiplicity; stop rules.
acceptance_test: All design blockers close before any confirmatory command is authorized.
notes: Do not inspect or optimize against new confirmatory results.

action: Execute the bounded synthetic distributed deadline pilot after authorization.
required_evidence: Complete multi-host traces; environment manifest; seeds; exclusions; deviation log.
acceptance_test: RID-C003-DEADLINE-001 is generated under the frozen contract and independently checked.
notes: Synthetic pilot only; no production deployment.

action: Run independent clean-machine reconstruction and qualified cryptography/systems review.
required_evidence: Independent commands, environment, hashes, outputs, objections, and signed dispositions.
acceptance_test: Central outputs reproduce or the claims are narrowed with discrepancies preserved.

action: Provide external or justified domain-equivalent validation, or narrow all real-world claims.
required_evidence: External/prospective evidence or explicit justified N/A with a narrower claim ceiling.
acceptance_test: No manuscript claim exceeds its verified evidence maturity.
notes: Field validation cannot be inferred from simulation.

action: Regenerate and visually validate all final figures, diagrams, and T1-T8 tables.
required_evidence: Canonical source data and code; final-size renders; grayscale/CVD/AT checks; human page review.
acceptance_test: Visual ledger has no unexplained warnings and all captions remain claim-safe.

action: Select a target venue and article type and verify current official requirements.
required_evidence: Dated venue portfolio; official rule URLs; reporting checklist; anonymity and AI policies.
acceptance_test: Venue artifacts are current and all requirements map to manuscript locations.
notes: Venue choice should follow the defensible evidence package.

action: Build and inspect the final submission package hermetically.
required_evidence: Digest-pinned offline build; SBOM; logs; PDF hash; font/reference/warning checks; rendered pages.
acceptance_test: Mechanical QA passes and accountable human approves the rendered PDF and portal preview.
notes: A clean compile alone does not establish scientific readiness.

action: Freeze complete authorship and disclosure metadata.
required_evidence: Human-approved author order, corresponding author, affiliations, CRediT roles, COI, funding, AI disclosure.
acceptance_test: All metadata is verified by every accountable author and any required institution.
notes: Deferred by explicit user instruction; do not infer now.

action: Commission independent adversarial manuscript review after evidence integration.
required_evidence: Signed reviewer ledger with competence and independence basis; objection dispositions.
acceptance_test: No critical FAIL or UNKNOWN remains hidden; unresolved risks are disclosed or claims narrowed.
notes: Current AI-assisted review is developmental only.

action: Close the C003 claim-to-figure and draft analysis-ledger contract.
required_evidence: Independent review and authorized execution of the primary, robustness, and negative-result contracts; source-linked F6-F8 assets and captions; or a human-approved narrowed matrix revision.
acceptance_test: Every claimed figure exists with canonical lineage and no draft ledger or table is treated as executed confirmatory analysis.
notes: Current F1-F5 lineage passes structurally; robustness and negative ledgers are draft/preauthorization only; the robustness ledger excludes evidence-entangled correlated-domain and deadline rows; F6-F8 are future outputs.
